job: Style rendered Markdown or long text without adding classes.
purpose: A reading container. Plain elements inside it are styled: 16/28 body text, 24/32 and 20/28 headings, ink links with a quiet underline, inline code on a 6% wash. Headings get anchors, wide tables scroll on their own, and components set in it keep their own type. data-size="sm" is for scanned text such as notes and FAQ answers.
useWhen: The content is Markdown or CMS output that you do not control the markup of.
A guide or article should read at 16/28 within the reading measure.

avoidWhen.when: Interface text, labels and short captions.
A note that should stand out in the article.
Text in a card or form.

variants.useWhen: Dense text: parameter notes, FAQ answers and changelog entries at 14/22.
The container holds a footnote list at its end.
